headline: 4 core contracts discovered: KPK token, OIV factory, governance structures across 7 chains
short_headline: KPK token + OIV factory + infrastructure contracts

findings.text: DEPLOYMENT.md lists KpkOivFactory at 0x0d94255fdE65D302616b02A2F070CdB21190d420 (same address across all supported chains: Mainnet, Arbitrum, Base, Optimism, Gnosis)
KPK governance token native chain is Ethereum Mainnet with initial supply 1 billion tokens (non-transferable at launch)
onchain-investment-vehicles README documents kpkShares contract: ERC20-upgradeable shares token managing subscription/redemption requests with role-based access control
kpk-token repository README confirms Transparent Proxy pattern for KPK token (upgradeable) with ERC20VotesUpgradeable for DAO governance
KpkOivFactory contract is already deployed and does not require re-deployment; individual funds deploy through it

rationale.verdict: Discovery identifies core protocol infrastructure: 1) KPK governance token (Ethereum), 2) KpkOivFactory (multi-chain), 3) kpkShares template implementation, 4) fund-specific Avatar Safe, Manager Safe, and Roles Modifiers deployed per fund. Cannot enumerate all fund instances without on-chain factory enumeration (capped at 50 per D6). Block explorer searches and D1 reconnaissance would be next step to surface deployed instances.

evidence.shows: KPK token repository: Transparent Proxy ERC20VotesUpgradeable, 1 billion initial supply, Ethereum Mainnet native chain, non-transferable at launch with owner-controlled allowlisting
KPK token specifications: ERC-20, 18 decimals, 1 billion supply, upgradeable Transparent Proxy pattern, ERC20VotesUpgradeable for governance, initially paused (non-transferable)

kpkShares contract implementation: tokenized fund with subscription/redemption requests, UUPS upgradeable, role-based access control (DEFAULT_ADMIN, OPERATOR), multi-asset support, fee management (management, performance, redemption fees)

kpkShares architecture: request-based subscription/redemption system, Asset Management for approved tokens, Fee Management (management, performance via watermark, redemption), Access Control with role hierarchy, TTL-based request cancellation

KpkOivFactory deployed at 0x0d94255fdE65D302616b02A2F070CdB21190d420 (same address on all supported chains: Mainnet, Arbitrum, Base, Optimism, Gnosis); KpkSharesDeployer at 0xA4B485Efe30F2b1D277b7A2279310239B26775F0. Factory deploys individual funds with Avatar Safe, Manager Safe, execRolesModifier, subRolesModifier, managerRolesModifier, kpkShares implementation and proxy.
KPK token contract address: 0xbF3F63D8AC133B16d7D50C015036b33219Dd8D23 on Ethereum blockchain

protocol_metadata.about: KPK is a scalable on-chain asset management protocol providing diversified DeFi exposure across protocols and chains. The protocol enables non-custodial treasury management for DAOs and institutions through tokenized investment vehicles (kpkShares), request-based subscription/redemption flows, and role-based governance via Safe and Zodiac Roles Modifier. KPK token holders participate in DAO governance for treasury parameters and strategic initiatives.
